fields.System.Title: OUT-405 — Zero pick triggering a count
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want a location where the picker found nothing to be counted
promptly, so that the error is corrected while its cause is still traceable.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a zero pick, then a count task is created for that location automatically.
  • - Given an existing open count task for the location, then a second is not created.
  • - Given the triggered count, then it is prioritised above scheduled cycle counts.
  • - Given the count, then it links back to the zero pick that caused it, for later
  • analysis.
  • - Given the zero pick, then it does not itself adjust stock — only the count does.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, counting |
| Tables | pick_task_line, count_task |
| Risks | Duplicate count tasks ([doc 09 §7.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); adjusting on suspicion rather than on a count |
| Tests | integration |
